title: GLOFICA DLT — Langton Autonomon: Architecture, Mathematical Foundations, and Protocol Specification for Autonomous Financial Artificial-Life Systems
description: An autonomous financial controller architecture combining a discretized tabular reinforcement-learning policy, a time-series forecasting service (Google TimesFM), constrained parameter mutation (7-locus genome), and a dedicated sovereign fullnode. The specification distinguishes practical observation-based control from stationary Markov decision processes and proves uniqueness of observation discretization, genome boundedness, Q-value bounds under bounded rewards, preservation of accounting invariants under barrier control functions, PAC sample-complexity lower bounds, and survival analysis under fixed operational runway.
